{{Quote|It's on a small island east of Kaadara. Follow the beach to the east and you shouldn't have any trouble finding it.|[[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] [[Quarsh Panaka/Legends|Panaka]]|<ref name="SWG:Ttb" />}}
The '''Skaak Tipper Hideout''', also known as the '''Island Hideout''', was a hideout on an island within the [[Eastern Great Grass Plains]] region of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]], neat the city of [[Kaadara]]. It was used by the criminal group known as the [[Skaak Tippers]] during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==History==
[[File:SkaakTipperHideoutJonni.jpg|200px|thumb|Jonni Skaak among his fellow Tippers in the hideout]]
{{Quote|Take out as many of them as you can. Then find their leader, Jonni Skaak, and take him down as well. If you succeed, they won't be planning an attack on Kaadara again any time soon.|Colonel Panaka|<ref name="SWG:Ttb" />}}
Sometime following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], [[Jonni Skaak]], formerly Jonthol Mazoon of the [[Royal Naboo Security Forces/Legends|Royal Naboo Security Forces]], stayed within this hideout. He was eventually [[Raid on the Skaak Tipper Hideout|killed]] by a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]], who recovered his personal journal.<ref name="SWG:Ttb" /> Using the [[Book/Legends|journal]], the spacer learned more about the life of Jonthol Mazoon, and how he ended up becoming a treasonous criminal.<ref name="SWG:TLaDoJS">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|The Life and Death of Jonni Skaak|Naboo}}</ref>

A spacer later went to the Hideout in order to acquire an [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Old Republic]] positional awareness triangulator chip from a [[MSE-series|mouse droid]] used by the Skaak Tippers.<ref name="SWG:ORDMTMD">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=class|Legacy|Old Republic Droid Modules: The Mouse Droid|Naboo}}</ref>

A few time later, a spacer sent by [[Boss/Legends|Boss]] [[Rugor Nass/Legends|Rugor Nass]] entered the Skaak Tipper Hideout to retrieve one of the pieces of a broken [[Gungan/Legends|Gungan]] artifact scattered by the [[Ultragungans]] in various areas of Naboo.<ref name="SWG:RaSPotsGA">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=class|Legacy|Recover all Six Pieces of the scattered Gungan Artifact|Naboo}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Skaak Tipper Hideout was a location in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:Ttb" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> The Skaak Tipper Bunker was added to the game as part of the "[[W:c:swg:Legacy Quest|Legacy Quest]]" with the release of the "[[W:c:swg:Publish 25 Notes for November 15, 2005|Publish 25]]," a.k.a. the "[[W:c:swg:New Game Enhancements|New Game Enhancements]]," on [[November 15]], [[2005]].<ref name="SonyCite-Publish Archive 2005">{{SonyCite|url=players/content.vm?id=64886&resource=publish|text=Publish Archive 2005}}</ref>
